package.name: amr_fleet_control
package.description: Fleet-level coordination. FleetMapNode composites per-robot SLAM maps into a single unified occupancy grid with a correctable inter-map transform and a scored selective update policy. TrajectoryPredictor publishes each robot's projected path for the other robots' costmap layers. TrafficControlNode arbitrates only those conflicts the local trajectory layer could not resolve, and suppresses Nav2 recovery whenever it yields. SKELETON: FleetMapNode in Phase 3, TrajectoryPredictor in Phase 6, TrafficControlNode in Phase 7.
